In addition to its research laboratories, D-ITET also runs a number of departmental services including the Microelectronic Design Centre and the mechanical workshop.
Facilities and Services
ETH provides several services to all its employees through ITS (‘Informatikdienste’). Additionally, D-ITET IT support group (ISG.EE) provides services to all employees of the department. Lists of available IT services by both organizations are provided below.

The AVETH Survival Guide contains useful information for new scientific staff across the entire ETH Zurich. It provides hints on how to find accommodation, regulations regarding health insurance and much more.
AVETH Survival Guide
The vmitet (Association of the Mittelbau at the Department of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering) is an autonomous association that represents the interests of the Mittelbau at the Department of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering (D-ITET) of ETH Zurich. The Mittelbau consists of doctoral students, post-docs, assistants, senior assistants, and scientific staff. vmitet is a member of the Academic Association of Scientific Staff at ETH Zurich (AVETH).
The VMITET HelpDesk is a strictly confidential mediation service for doctoral students and scientific staff. Offered on a peer-to-peer level by volunteers, who act as a first point of contact for early stage conflicts, it is a safe place to discuss a dispute and come about its resolution.
